title: Ġgantija
visualBrief: Two specific roofless apsidal temple groups with open entrances,shared curved megalithic perimeter and surviving internal wall masses. The75-point normal-map outline supplies the actual walls and open chambers;the larger archaeological park is not authored as a building.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained Q216862/way29546608 identifies the archaeological site. The standard PMTiles actual temple building35184714819646 supplies a75-vertex wall-mass outline with both apsidal chamber groups and southeast entrance corridors,about43×45m. The independent site boundary is about94×89m and is not the model footprint.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: One ordinary2020 aerial exterior picture shows pale irregular limestone blocks,high back perimeter and lower open chamber walls. The displayed article gives a6m maximum wall height. Individual wall heights,stone grouping and surviving portal tops are visualization estimates,not a surveyed reconstruction. Large orthostats occupy the lower outer wall faces; smaller upper courses and interior stone groups are estimates guided by that picture. The mapped wall mass,open chambers and entrance gaps remain unchanged.
